v1.change: Initial prompt and schema. (The first scoring run showed 68% framing/raised-by, which was a validator bug: pandas read the truth value 'n/a' as missing. Fixed in validation.py before any prompt change; the v1 numbers below are the corrected ones.)

v2.change: Tightened the decision-criteria definition: only criteria the buyer presents as influencing their choice count; procedural mentions (security-review logistics, asking for a quote, timeline) do not. Target was exceeded already by v1 on framing/raised-by, so those fields were left alone.

scoring_note: After v2, two scoring artifacts were fixed in validation.py: 'OpenAI direct' (the dataset's label) is treated as 'OpenAI', and multi-part quotes joined with ' | ' or '...' are checked part by part. Both only affected the competitor and quote-grounding rows; v1 rows above were scored before this fix (competitors_inference was 86%/92%, quote grounding 96%/90%). The v2 latent_standalone row was re-scored after the scenario was strengthened (new transcripts); the v1 row was measured on the earlier latent transcripts.
